rows.name: Django
rows.reason: Its ORM, authentication, admin, email, and file APIs cover the core booking application; add durable background jobs.

rows.name: Ruby on Rails with an admin/authentication add-on
rows.reason: Rails documents CRUD, mail, jobs and storage, but admin/authentication remains unverified. ActiveAdmin relocation, compatible version, authentication setup and Rails queue backend need checking; not an established complete setup.

rows.name: Django
rows.reason: Django documents application facilities; Celery supplies explicit job-queue integration. The summary neither requires every feature in Django core nor forbids a separate task processor.

rows.name: AdonisJS 5
rows.reason: TypeScript backend documents CRUD, authentication, mail and files. Complete administration and durable queues are not established by inspected evidence; further component selection is necessary.

rows.name: Ruby on Rails 7
rows.reason: Models, conventions, background-job integration, mail and attachments support booking workflows. Accounts, staff administration and a durable queue backend still require implementation or component selection.

rows.name: Jekyll without an additional backend
rows.reason: It generates static pages; without an additional backend it cannot supply persistent booking CRUD, authentication, administrative workflows, background jobs, or transactional email.

rows.name: Cookiecutter Django
rows.reason: Cookiecutter Django packages accounts, mail/media, deployment and optional Celery. Generated dependencies and operating choices need maintenance; current main was not verified at the 2022 cutoff.

rows.name: Supabase
rows.reason: Supabase supplies PostgreSQL APIs, identity and object storage for records, sign-in and images. Customer/operational UI, booking rules and complete queue/mail workflows remain separate responsibilities.

rows.name: Laravel 9
rows.reason: Models, authentication, queues, scheduling, mail and storage support booking backends. Staff interface needs separate implementation/package selection; durable workers and services require operation.

rows.name: Laravel with Filament
rows.reason: Laravel 9.x/Filament 2.x docs cover queues, mail, storage, authentication and admin. Add-on runtime/access setup required; some evidence is search excerpts. Exact pre-question page revisions remain unestablished.

rows.name: Spring RTS engine
rows.reason: C++/Lua/OpenGL RTS game engine does not match a lodging-reservation application framework. No concrete transfer into the requested application stack is established.

rows.name: Spring RTS engine
rows.reason: This repository is a real-time-strategy game engine, with no relevant web-application framework for booking CRUD, authentication, administration, mail, or storage.

rows.name: Django with Celery
rows.reason: Django/Celery fits; internal admin requires custom public booking screens. Django 4.1 authentication incompletely verified; 4.1 is now unsupported, used as historical evidence, not a deployment recommendation.

rows.name: Jekyll without an additional backend
rows.reason: Jekyll without an additional backend produces static files, not runtime booking CRUD, authentication, administration, jobs, mail or files. Adding an application backend changes the supplied configuration.

rows.name: Django 4.1
rows.reason: Models, authentication, admin, email and file APIs support booking-application work. Durable background jobs need another implementation; customer booking flows and domain rules remain custom application work.
